queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS n_lines, sum(l_extendedprice) AS revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate + 17 BETWEEN DATE '1994-04-13' AND DATE '1994-04-13' + 6
SELECT s.s_suppkey, (SELECT sum(l.l_quantity) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) AS supplied_qty FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = 7
SELECT count(*) AS n_customers FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey NOT IN (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-04-13' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-04-13' + 17)

SELECT count(*) AS n_orders, avg(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_price, max(o.o_shippriority) AS max_priority FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-04-13' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-04-13' + 17

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT l_orderkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-04-13' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1994-04-13' + 17) SELECT count(*) AS n_lines, sum(l_extendedprice) AS revenue FROM recent WHERE l_quantity >= 4
